purpose: Test the official RLinf actor weight/optimizer offload implementation as a resource-only way to run frozen V15.7 alongside the unchanged Pi0.5 rollout, reward and GRPO computation on one RTX 5090.
classification: resource-feasibility diagnostic; not a formal policy result

official_rl.offload_implementation: official RLinf FSDP actor offload_param_and_grad/offload_optimizer implementation
